installation_summary:
## Method
Followed Installation.md: the app is a static HTML/JS web application deployed to a web server's document root, with an Elasticsearch service as the data backend. Both prerequisites were installed locally in the Ubuntu 22.04 container and the app was deployed and verified with a real headless browser.

## Components installed (application container: root of the active benchmark container, /workspace holds the source repo)
- **Web server:** nginx 1.18 (doc root `/var/www/html`), configured to serve static files and execute `.php` via FastCGI. PHP 8.1 + php-fpm (socket `/run/php/php8.1-fpm.sock`) plus the `php8.1-curl` extension (required by the shipped proxy). Both daemons started manually (no systemd in container).
- **Elasticsearch:** 7.17.28 (open-source build from artifacts.elastic.co) installed at `/opt/elasticsearch-7.17.28` (symlink `/opt/es`), running as user `elastic`, single-node, `http.port: 9200`, `network.host: 127.0.0.1`, cluster name `index-data-explorer`. Config at `/opt/elasticsearch-7.17.28/config/elasticsearch.yml`. CORS enabled with `http.cors.allow-origin: http://localhost` so the default direct mode works from a browser.
- **Web app deployment (per guide):** copied `config/`, `externalPackages/`, `i18n/`, `src/`, `php/`, `examples/`, top-level HTML pages (`index.html`, `csvParse.html`, `plausibilityCheck.html`, `elasticsearchIndexAdministration.html`, `logo.png`) and an empty toplevel `data/` folder into `/var/www/html`.
- **Sample data:** indices `index_data_explorer_demo` (10 docs) and `spotify_tracks` (6 docs, mapping from `examples/spotify/data/elasticsearch_spotify_tracks.json`) created via the REST API so explorer pages have data.

## Configuration state
- Shipped defaults already match this deployment: `config/baseConfig.json` → `elasticsearchBaseUrl: http://localhost:9200`, `proxyUrl: null` (direct mode) — no change needed.
- Proxy mode also functional: `/php/dataExplorerProxy.php` forwards JSON to ES (verified: search returned 6 hits for `spotify_tracks`). Note: upstream proxy quirk — PHP `json_decode` converts empty JSON objects `{}` to `[]`, so `{"match_all":{}}`-style bodies fail in proxy mode only; real match/aggregation queries work, and the default direct mode is unaffected.

## Access points / startup commands
- Web UI: `http://localhost/` (main explorer), `http://localhost/examples/spotify/indexSpotify.html`, `http://localhost/examples/komono/index.html`, etc.
- Elasticsearch: `http://localhost:9200` (health: `green`).
- Restarts: `nginx`; `/usr/sbin/php-fpm8.1 --daemonize --fpm-config /etc/php/8.1/fpm/php-fpm.conf`; ES: `su -s /bin/bash elastic -c "ES_JAVA_OPTS='-Xms1g -Xmx1g' /opt/es/bin/elasticsearch -d -p /opt/elasticsearch-7.17.28/elasticsearch.pid"`.
- Verification assets: `/tmp/verify/` (Playwright scripts, screenshots `main_page.png`, `spotify_barchart.png`).

## Incomplete/unknown
- KOSIS example pages require KOSIS dataset import via the `bin/` CLI scripts (Node 18 installed for that) to show real data; the guide-mandated toplevel `data/` folder exists for them.
- No issues otherwise; all guide steps completed.
additional_actions: Installed and started nginx and PHP-FPM (and php8.1-curl, required by the shipped proxy) as the guide's 'WebServer' prerequisite
Installed and started Elasticsearch 7.17.28 as the guide's 'Elasticsearch Service' prerequisite (dedicated elastic user, single-node, port 9200)
Enabled Elasticsearch CORS (http.cors.allow-origin http://localhost) so the shipped default config/baseConfig.json (direct mode, proxyUrl null) works from a browser

Created two sample indices (index_data_explorer_demo with 10 docs; spotify_tracks with 6 docs using the mapping shipped in examples/spotify/data) and bulk-loaded sample documents so the explorer pages have data
Installed Node.js 18 via NodeSource (for the repo's bin/ helper scripts)
Set vm.max_map_count check (already 1048576, no change needed) and created /run/php for the PHP-FPM socket
Verified the installation with a real headless Chromium browser (Playwright) instead of only curl, exercising the actual user flow
verification:
Verification method: (1) service/HTTP checks and (2) real-browser end-to-end runs with Playwright/Chromium against the deployed site. Observed results:
- `curl -s http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health` → `{"status":"green",...}`; `_cat/indices` shows `index_data_explorer_demo` (10 docs) and `spotify_tracks` (6 docs), both green.
- Static assets: `curl -o /dev/null -w %{http_code}` → 200 for `/index.html`, `/examples/spotify/indexSpotify.html`, `/config/baseConfig.json`, and all referenced JS/CSS/i18n files.
- PHP proxy: `curl -X POST http://localhost/php/dataExplorerProxy.php -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"indexName":"spotify_tracks","indexAction":"_search","requestType":"post","dataForRemote":{"size":1,"query":{"match":{"name":"Blinding Lights"}}}}'` → ES JSON with total hits value 1 (proxy forwards correctly).
- Browser E2E `http://localhost/index.html`: `#chooseIndex` populated with all ES indices; selected `index_data_explorer_demo` → mapping loaded; chose field `name.keyword` + output `barChart` + dimension; `#getResults` sent a real `_search` → HTTP 200 with `hits.total.value: 10`; an SVG bar chart was rendered in `#graphicsWrapper` (SVG_COUNT 1). Screenshot `/tmp/verify/main_page.png`.
- Browser E2E `http://localhost/examples/spotify/indexSpotify.html`: filter field chooser populated with 22 fields from the `spotify_tracks` mapping; query on `artists.name` → `_search` HTTP 200, `hits.total.value: 6`; SVG bar chart rendered. Screenshot `/tmp/verify/spotify_barchart.png`.
Exit codes: all verification curls/health checks returned 0; Playwright scripts completed without page errors.
reported_outcome_evidence: Elasticsearch health: curl http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health → {"cluster_name":"index-data-explorer","status":"green",...} (green; earlier 4 shards active)
Indices: curl http://localhost:9200/_cat/indices?v → 'green open index_data_explorer_demo ... 10 docs' and 'green open spotify_tracks ... 6 docs' (after setting replicas=0)
Web app served by nginx: curl http://localhost/index.html → HTTP 200; all deployed static assets (externalPackages JS/CSS, config JSON, src JS, i18n) → HTTP 200

PHP proxy functional: POST /php/dataExplorerProxy.php with match query on spotify_tracks → ES JSON total hits value 1 (proves nginx→php-fpm→ES path works; also returned 'curl_init undefined' fix confirmed after installing php8.1-curl)

CORS for direct mode: curl -i -H 'Origin: http://localhost' to ES _search → 'HTTP/1.1 200 OK' with 'access-control-allow-origin: http://localhost'; preflight OPTIONS → allow-methods incl. POST, allow-headers incl. Content-Type

Browser E2E (Playwright/Chromium) http://localhost/index.html: '#chooseIndex' options = ['Bitte auswählen','.geoip_databases','index_data_explorer_demo','spotify_tracks']; after selecting index_data_explorer_demo, field chooser = ['name','region']; running barChart search → NET: 'search 200 {"took":12,..."hits":{"total":{"value":10,"relation":"eq"}' and SVG_COUNT: 1 (bar chart rendered)

Browser E2E http://localhost/examples/spotify/indexSpotify.html: filter fields populated from mapping (22 fields incl. artists.name, name, popularity...); barChart on artists.name → 'search 200 ... hits.total.value 6' and SVG_COUNT: 1
